purpose: Targeted static diagnostic of the visible response to one known multicolor shape, paired with an identical RGB128 control. Not a random natural-scene or overall-generalization sample.
informed_by: The completed n05_dots_s0-light-native pilot rejection audit; no other newly captured actual pixels were read to choose these regions.

world.color_space: sRGB with frozen embedded ICC profile; code-value arithmetic, not linear radiance
world.position_basis: Known frozen rest geometry; targeted diagnostic. A nominal source region is not recovered native output geometry.

rasterization.sample_centers: For output pixel (i,j), subpixel (a,b) is (i+(a+.5)/4,j+(b+.5)/4), a,b=0..3.
rasterization.shape_membership: Analytic disk or even-odd polygon interior; boundary included by disk <= and polygon even-odd half-open crossings. Exact implementation and dependencies are frozen.
rasterization.color_band_rule: u=x-center_x. Left band u < -radius/4, middle -radius/4 <= u < radius/4, right u >= radius/4, intersected with shape support.
rasterization.composition: For each RGB channel, sum 16 subpixel code values including background and divide by16; round half-up using (integer_sum+8)//16. No output-selected normalization.
rasterization.coverage: Lossless integer subpixel-count RLE per color band, denominator16. Sum counts is the exact AA mask for the declared sampler.
rasterization.triangle_boundary: 3 circumcircle vertices with angle -pi/2+2*pi*k/3, k=0..2; orientation fixed in both splits
rasterization.star_boundary: 10 alternating outer r / inner .45r vertices with angle -pi/2+pi*k/5, k=0..9; orientation fixed
rasterization.asymmetric_rule: Divide all given vertex coordinates by their maximum Euclidean norm, then multiply by radius and translate. Save resulting float64 world vertices.
rasterization.source_measurements: Coverage-weighted pixel-center area/centroid/covariance with exact coverage counts; also keep analytic center, circumradius and vertices. Pixel-center moments are not continuum shape moments.

palette_assignment: Case index k uses palette[(band+k) mod3] for left/middle/right band, band=0..2.

draw_order: RGB perturbation array in band-major/channel-minor order
test_variation.policy: One predeclared draw per test case, no rejection/resampling. Check canvas and nominal target support, report generation failure rather than replacing seed.

calibration.seed_use: Registered independent pair identifiers; calibration geometry/color is fixed by cases and consumes zero RNG draws.

test.seed_use: The fixed test_variation draw order determines independent center/radius/color variation; no actual test capture has been read.

pair_contract.control: Exactly the same full-canvas RGB128 background, profile, encoder options and pixel bytes for all eight controls; no identifiers embedded in PNG metadata.
pair_contract.shape: One and only one ideal shape on that background, using three known local color bands.
pair_contract.metadata: Both input manifest entries bind the same pair metadata. Metadata stores analytic boundary, world/pixel/point coordinates, colors, original coverage masks, areas/moments, source PNG and pixel hashes.
pair_contract.capture: Not performed by this packet. Root must retain native/candidate roles, selection, theme, foreground, background and state timing. Paired captures need repeat/state checks; equal controls do not guarantee identical private native state.

interpretation_limits: This packet deliberately targets known geometric regions; disjoint test seeds do not make the design blind or representative of arbitrary scenes.
A control/shape difference is an observed conditional image response, not a proven linear shift-invariant PSF, linear transmittance, physical thickness, IOR, or uniquely inverted native renderer.
Global material adaptation, nonlinear color/contrast changes, foreground layering, selected lens and base Dock can affect a response. Do not infer their absence from a difference image.
Responses can be blurred, warped, split, obscured, clipped, fused with foreground or unidentified. Weak detection does not prove physical disappearance.
Different families have different source areas at the same circumradius. Preserve source area and threshold sensitivity rather than pooling raw visible area.
Freeze analysis/thresholds using calibration before opening test captures. Output-informed changes require a new frozen version and new test seeds; retain the earlier failures.
preservation: Preserve this protocol, generator, README, ICC, freeze, both manifests, all16 fixture PNGs, eight metadata/coverage tables, input atlas and verification report. Do not overwrite a freeze to revise the design.
